newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $557 mln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $557 mln for Tuesday.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for Tuesday are expected to total $557 million in 40 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $261 million million in 28 sales. The largest is a $90 million Alameda County, Calif., transit deal at 1300 EST.
Negotiated sales total $296 million in 12 offerings. The largest is a $72.7 million District of Columbia revenue bond deal through Lehman Brothers.
An additional $145 million of deals are on the possible list, meaning underwriters have said they may price the deal sometime next week depending on market conditions.
